title: Help & requests
description: Not sure where something goes? Start from what's happening.
myRequestsLink: Already asked for something? See where it stands in My requests.

it.title: Something technical isn't working
it.when: Your computer, phone, an account or a tool — IT picks it up as a ticket.

error.title: A mistake happened in our work
error.when: A quality issue or customer complaint to record and follow up on.

idea.title: I have an idea
idea.when: Something that could work better. The whole team can see and vote on it.

absence.title: I need time off
absence.when: Vacation or other absence, sent to Clockodo for approval.

howto.title: How do I…?
howto.when: Step-by-step guides for our tools and processes.

ask.title: Ask a question
ask.when: The AI assistant answers from what's in the wiki.

who.title: Who can help me with this?
who.when: Find a colleague, their team and whether they're reachable now.

status.title: Is something down right now?
status.when: Current incidents, planned maintenance and what's new.

pageFeedbackHint: Something in the intranet itself is confusing or broken? Open your account menu on that page and choose “Feedback on this page”.
